environment.semantics: Salias fast engine and Aeron exclusive publications; multiple subscribers receive every published message (fanout), not competing consumers
environment.capacity: Salias fast ring stores 1 MiB of payload data per producer for SPSC/SPMC and 256 KiB for MPSC/MPMC producers, plus fixed-slot metadata; Aeron uses 1 MiB terms in a multi-term log, so total mapped capacities differ
environment.aggregation: Median and range across measured run values; latency uses each run's worst subscriber, never pooled histograms
environment.payload_limit: Logical payloads are 64/256 B; latency writes 16 B and throughput 8 B. Counts and samples are checked, not full content, sequence, or duplicate logic
